chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from more than one narrator, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from Zurarah, who said:
I heard Aba Ja'far عليه السلام saying:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام was brought a غلام who had stolen, so he cut off the tips of his fingers. Then he said: If you return to it, I will surely cut it off.
Then he said: Indeed, no one carried it out except the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and I.

key_terms.أَقْطَعَنَّهَا: I will surely cut it off
key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فَطَرَّفَ: he cut off the extremity or tip

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam say about the punishment for theft under Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal punishment carried out by Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام in a theft case, in which the fingers were partially cut and a warning was given against repeating the offense. It also emphasizes that this specific implementation was performed only by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, underscoring its authority within the prophetic and Imamic sunnah.
